methods.orbit_greedy: Construct balanced 51-coalition batches in which every player occupies every cyclic position once.
methods.row_greedy: Choose each coalition from a candidate pool to best complement the coalitions already selected.

game.modeling_note: Maine and Nebraska are treated as whole-state blocs even though the real Electoral College can split their votes.

ground_truth.algorithm: exact cardinality-weight DP with leave-one-out polynomial division
ground_truth.complexity: O(n^2 * quota) time and O(n * quota) memory
